answer: Each epoch each identity grades 5 peer answers in the sable ledger, 10 minutes per grade. A ripple score compares each grade with the consensus; deviation above 1 point costs 2 POA from a 20 POA stake locked 90 days, and a second offence doubles the slash. 100 fakes need 500 grades per epoch, 83 hours, plus 2,000 POA locked; rushed grades fail consensus more often, so marginal cost rises with every fake. Three clean epochs move an identity to the umber tier, stake 10 POA. Grading rings can game consensus, so each batch hides 2 controls; members grading them wrong lose their stake at once.
